title: IR-Fusion: A Fusion Framework for Static IR Drop Analysis Combining Numerical Solution and Machine Learning
problem: Static IR drop analysis for on-chip power grids is computationally prohibitive at circuit scale; traditional numerical solvers are accurate but extremely time-consuming while machine learning methods sacrifice interpretability and scalability.
motivation: As circuit complexity grows, fast and accurate IR drop analysis is critical for power integrity verification, but traditional EDA tools become impractical and pure ML methods lack robustness across diverse designs.
method: Combines efficient AMG-PCG numerical solver producing rough solutions with an Inception Attention U-Net for refinement; captures multi-scale power grid features through hierarchical fusion of numerical-structural information and applies augmented curriculum learning to handle design diversity.
key_novelty: Hybrid numerical-ML fusion framework combining solver accuracy with ML speed and adaptability.
contributions: Fusion strategy leveraging AMG-PCG numerical solver with deep learning refinement
Inception Attention U-Net capturing multi-scale power grid structure and interactions
Augmented curriculum learning strategy for diverse PG designs
Significantly improved accuracy versus pure ML methods with fewer solver iterations than pure numerical
limitations: Specific accuracy quantification and applicability to dynamic IR drop analysis not addressed in abstract.
